metaTitle: Gabriel Moro — Senior Mobile Engineer & 1:1 Mentor
metaDescription: Senior mobile engineer and tech lead working with Android, Kotlin Multiplatform and Flutter. 1:1 mentoring for developers moving into senior and lead roles. The first call is free.

hero.title: Become the mobile engineer
hero.lede: I’m Gabriel Moro. For almost a decade I’ve built Android, Kotlin Multiplatform and Flutter products used by millions — and I mentor the developers who want to grow into senior and lead roles.
hero.portraitAlt: Portrait of Gabriel Moro, smiling and wearing glasses.

about.heading: Hands-on engineering, human mentoring.
paragraphs: I’ve been a mobile engineer since 2017, building and leading products at scale — apps with 35M+ users and 100M+ downloads — as a senior engineer and tech lead. Today I work with Flutter and the VTEX ecosystem at Kobe.

Teaching has always been part of the job, not an extra. I’ve mentored developers, run internal workshops, spoken at GDGs and written about mobile for years. My approach is simple: less abstract theory, more code, architecture decisions and a concrete next step.

mentoring.heading: Guidance from someone who has already walked the path.
mentoring.lede: A few 1:1 slots open for developers who want to grow faster than they could alone — combining almost a decade of mobile in production with hands-on mentoring of Android and Kotlin Multiplatform teams.
forYou: Mid-level developers aiming for a senior role.
Senior developers stepping into technical leadership.
Android and Flutter developers moving into Kotlin Multiplatform.
Anyone preparing for international hiring processes.

experience.heading: Almost a decade shipping mobile products.
experience.lede: Recent roles. Earlier history on LinkedIn.

roles.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Building and evolving mobile e-commerce apps with Flutter and Dart, across the full product lifecycle.
Improving architecture, engineering practices and automated testing for scalable, high-quality delivery.
Integrating with the VTEX ecosystem and supporting technical leadership, code reviews and mentoring.

roles.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Core features for a cash-back app with 35M+ users, handling millions of daily transactions.
Led Kotlin Multiplatform (Compose Multiplatform) adoption and mentored mobile developers.
Feature flags, CI/CD with linting and Maestro UI tests, and architecture standards across the team.

roles.title: Senior Android Engineer
bullets: Delivered Android features for a carrier app with 25M–35M+ active users and 100M+ downloads.
Mentored Android developers and built complex features with Hilt, Jetpack Compose and multi-module projects.

roles.title: Senior Android Engineer
bullets: Built core Android features for an enterprise video recording and livestreaming app.
Implemented HD local recording, low-latency capture and a dynamic multi-participant video display.
Worked with WebRTC, Dagger and Jetpack Components on a live production product.
